program: Geosciences Core Research: Atmospheric, Geospace, Earth and Ocean Sciences (GEO Core)

requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted following the rules in the funding opportunity and the Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG).
requirements.source_quote: All proposals must be submitted in accordance with the requirements specified in the funding opportunity and in the [Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG) and its supplements](/policies/pappg "NSF Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG)").
requirements.source_heading: Important information for proposers and award recipients

requirements.text: Proposals must comply with the standard NSF award terms and conditions applicable to grants and cooperative agreements.
requirements.source_quote: All NSF grants and cooperative agreements are subject to the applicable set of NSF [award terms and conditions](/awards/terms-conditions "Award Terms and Conditions").
requirements.source_heading: Important information for proposers and award recipients

requirements.text: Proposals must adhere to NSF's updated research security policies for funded projects.
requirements.source_quote: NSF has updated its [research security policies](/notices/important/important-notice-no-149-updates-nsf-research-security/in149 "Important Notice No. 149: Updates to NSF Research Security Policies") for NSF funded projects.
requirements.source_heading: Important information for proposers and award recipients

requirements.text: Full proposals are due by 5 p.m. at the submitting organization's local time.
requirements.source_quote: **Full Proposal Deadline(s)** (due by 5 p.m. submitting organization's local time):

requirements.text: Proposals must be prepared in accordance with the NSF Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG).
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must be prepared in accordance with the *[NSF Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG)](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/pappg)*.

requirements.text: The version of the guide used must be the one in effect on the proposal's due date.
requirements.source_quote: Use the version of the guide that is in effect on the proposal's due date.

requirements.text: The proposal must demonstrate intellectually ambitious and potentially transformative research.
requirements.source_quote: NSF is especially interested in intellectually ambitious and potentially transformative research

requirements.text: The proposal should create opportunities for exceptional early-career investigators.
requirements.source_quote: work that creates opportunities for exceptional early-career investigators

requirements.text: If using emerging technologies like AI or advanced computation, their use must be scientifically justified rather than incidental.
requirements.source_quote: The use of these tools should be scientifically justified rather than incidental.

requirements.text: The proposal must adhere to standards of scientific rigor, transparency, reproducibility, and research integrity.
requirements.source_quote: NSF also expects the highest standards of scientific rigor, transparency, reproducibility, research integrity

requirements.text: The proposal must adhere to the tenets of Gold Standard Science as appropriate for the field and modality.
requirements.source_quote: and adherence to tenets of [Gold Standard Science](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/gold-standard-science) in proposals, as appropriate for the field of science and research modality.

requirements.text: The proposal should challenge prevailing paradigms, ask important questions, or develop new theories/methods.
requirements.source_quote: NSF places particular emphasis on projects that challenge prevailing paradigms, ask important questions, develop new theories or methods

requirements.text: The proposal should create research tools or datasets that enable further research.
requirements.source_quote: create research tools or datasets that enable further research

requirements.text: The proposal should open new lines of inquiry.
requirements.source_quote: or open new lines of inquiry.

requirements.text: NSF strongly encourages novel connections across scientific domains (interdisciplinary work).
requirements.source_quote: it therefore strongly encourages proposals that forge novel connections across scientific domains.

requirements.text: The proposal should leverage emerging technologies to make new modes, methods, or scales of science possible.
requirements.source_quote: proposals that leverage emerging technologies, including AI, advanced computation, and automation, to make new modes, methods, or scales of science possible.

requirements.text: Use of tools should open fundamentally new scientific questions, reveal invisible patterns, or enable new capabilities beyond accelerating workflows.
requirements.source_quote: Beyond accelerating existing workflows, such tools open fundamentally new scientific questions, reveal patterns invisible to prior methods, and enable experimental and analytical capabilities.

requirements.text: For ambitious, transformative research, proposals requesting up to five years of support are encouraged.
requirements.source_quote: NSF encourages proposals requesting up to five years of support.

requirements.text: For preliminary or time-sensitive work, investigators should consider using specific mechanisms like Planning Proposal, RAPID, EAGER, and RAISE.
requirements.source_quote: For preliminary or time-sensitive work, NSF encourages investigators to use mechanisms such as Planning Proposal, RAPID, EAGER, and RAISE

requirements.text: NSF welcomes submissions from all researchers, particularly those earlier in their careers.
requirements.source_quote: NSF welcomes submissions from all researchers, particularly those earlier in their careers

requirements.text: If submitting via Research.gov, proposals must follow PAPPG guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: For proposals submitted via Research.gov, *[PAPPG](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/pappg)* guidelines apply.

requirements.text: If submitting via Grants.gov, proposals must follow the NSF Grants.gov Application Guide guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: For proposals submitted via Grants.gov, *[NSF Grants.gov Application Guide](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/document/nsf-grantsgov-application-guide)* guidelines apply.

requirements.text: Voluntary committed cost sharing is not allowed in the proposal.
requirements.source_quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

requirements.text: Proposals can be submitted at any time; there is no fixed deadline.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals Accepted Anytime

requirements.text: If a project spans multiple programs, investigators must select the program that best aligns with the project's primary focus.
requirements.source_quote: In cases where projects span multiple programs, investigators should select the program that best aligns with the project's primary focus.

requirements.text: Proposals are encouraged to advance translational impacts, such as innovations and patents, that benefit the American people.
requirements.source_quote: The programs encourage foundational research in the geosciences that lead to translational impacts, including innovations and patents, that benefit the American people.

requirements.text: Proposals should involve collaborations with industry, national laboratories, international partners, and public-sector organizations.
requirements.source_quote: The programs support projects that involve collaborations with industry, national laboratories, international partners, and public-sector organizations.

requirements.text: Proposals are encouraged to leverage appropriate cyberinfrastructure or physical research infrastructure.
requirements.source_quote: Projects may leverage research infrastructure – cyberinfrastructure or physical infrastructure – as appropriate.

requirements.text: NSF GEO encourages proposal submissions from institutions in EPSCoR jurisdictions.
requirements.source_quote: NSF GEO encourages proposal submissions from institutions in the [Established Program to Stimulate Competitive Research (EPSCoR) jurisdictions](https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/epscor/state-websites).

requirements.text: Proposals should advance one or more of the following measures of success: peer-reviewed publications/scholarly outputs, creation/curation/expansion of publicly accessible data sets, or development of new methods/tools/models/instrumentation.
requirements.source_quote:
**Proposals should advance one or more of the following measures of success:**

* Peer-reviewed publications and other scholarly outputs that advance knowledge in the geosciences
* Creation, curation, or expansion of publicly accessible data sets that enable further scientific research
* Development of new methods, tools, models, or instrumentation that improve the understanding of geoscience systems

requirements.text: Proposers must be entities eligible to submit proposals to the NSF as defined in the PAPPG Chapter I.E.
requirements.source_quote: The categories of proposers eligible to submit proposals to the National Science Foundation are identified in the *NSF Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide* [(PAPPG), Chapter I.E](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/pappg/eligibility).

requirements.text: Unaffiliated individuals are not eligible to submit proposals.
requirements.source_quote: Unaffiliated individuals are not eligible to submit proposals in response to this solicitation.

requirements.text: Collaborative proposals submitted as separate submissions from multiple organizations must use Research.gov for submission.
requirements.source_quote: All collaborative proposals submitted as separate submissions from multiple organizations must be submitted via Research.gov.

requirements.text: Proposals involving off-site work must include a one-page description of safety protocols in the 'Special Information and Supplementary Documents' section.
requirements.source_quote: The Off-Site Safety Protocol should be uploaded as a 1-page document in the "Special Information and Supplementary Documents" section.

requirements.text: Proposals requiring access to community research platforms must upload a copy of the request filed with platform managers as a supplementary document.
requirements.source_quote: file appropriate requests with the platform managers and upload a copy of the request as a supplementary document.

requirements.text: Proposals involving vessels from the Academic Research Fleet must include the UNOLS Science & Marine Equipment request form as a supplementary document.
requirements.source_quote: include a University National Oceanographic Laboratory System Science & Marine Equipment (SME) [request form](https://www.unols.org/document/unols-ship-time-requests-ship-scheduling-and-shared-use-equipment) as a supplementary document.

requirements.text: If approval for permits has been obtained, the approval should be included in the 'Special Information and Supplementary Documents' section.
requirements.source_quote: If approval has been obtained, it should be included in the "Special Information and Supplementary Documents" section.

requirements.text: The Project Description must describe how permitting for collecting, destroying (if applicable), and importing/exporting samples will be addressed.
requirements.source_quote: Principal investigators are required to describe in the "Project Description" how permitting for collecting, destroying (if applicable) and importing/exporting samples will be addressed.

requirements.text: The Data Management and Sharing Plan must describe how the proposal meets NSF GEO's requirement to deposit final data sets, metadata, derived products, software/code, and physical samples in a long-lived public archive upon publication or within two years of collection.
requirements.source_quote: How the proposal will meet that requirement must be described in the "Data Management and Sharing Plan."

requirements.text: If full compliance with data deposition is impracticable or inadvisable, the Data Management and Sharing Plan must describe the extent of compliance and justify limits on accessibility and sharing.
requirements.source_quote: Where full compliance is impracticable or inadvisable, the plan must describe the extent of compliance and justify any limits on accessibility and sharing.

requirements.text: Proposals must be submitted through Research.gov or Grants.gov unless explicitly noted otherwise.
requirements.source_quote: You can submit proposals in response to this solicitation through Research.gov or Grants.gov, unless otherwise noted.

requirements.text: Proposals must be evaluated based on the two National Science Board-approved merit review criteria: Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts.
requirements.source_quote: All NSF proposals are evaluated through use of the two National Science Board-approved merit review criteria:
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: All proposals must pass an initial compliance check before proceeding to review.
requirements.source_quote: After a proposal passes an initial compliance check

requirements.text: If all else is equal after merit review, preference may be given to institutions with lower indirect cost rates.
requirements.source_quote: all else being equal after merit review, NSF may give preference to institutions with lower indirect cost rates.

requirements.text: Recipients must adhere to pass-through entity requirements when establishing and managing subawards.
requirements.source_quote: recipients of NSF awards must adhere to the requirements for pass-through entities in establishing and managing subawards issued ensuring alignment with Administration and NSF policies and priorities.

requirements.text: Proposers should be aware that awards may include termination for convenience provisions.
requirements.source_quote: proposers should be aware that NSF awards offered under this funding opportunity may include termination for convenience provisions.

requirements.text: The principal investigator must submit annual project reports.
requirements.source_quote: NSF requires the principal investigator of every grant to submit annual project reports

requirements.text: The principal investigator must submit a project outcomes report for the general public.
requirements.source_quote: and a project outcomes report for the general public.

requirements.text: Annual and final project reports must include data and sample management activities as designated in the Data Management and Sharing Plan.
requirements.source_quote: Annual and final project reports shall include data and sample management activities as designated in the [Data Management and Sharing Plan]

requirements.text: Data and sample management activities must be included in the Project Outcomes Report.
requirements.source_quote: Data and sample management activities shall also be included in the Project Outcomes Report

requirements.text: Products must be indexed in the NSF Public Access Repository (NSF-PAR).
requirements.source_quote: products shall be indexed in the [NSF Public Access Repository (NSF-PAR)]

cap_usd.quote: NSF seeks proposals spanning a wide range of funding levels and project durations. (No award ceiling is stated.)

max_years.quote: "The Foundation encourages proposers to request funding for durations of three to five years when such durations are necessary for completion of the proposed work"

cost_share.quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

equipment_threshold_usd.quote: revised to increase the equipment threshold from $5,000 to $10,000 to align with updates provided in Title 2 CFR § 200.

subaward_mtdc_limit_usd.quote: 2 CFR 200.1: MTDC includes "up to the first $50,000 of each subaward (regardless of the period of performance of the subawards under the award)".

requires_mentoring_plan.quote: "each proposal that requests funding to support postdoctoral scholars or graduate students must upload under 'Mentoring Plan' in the supplementary documentation section"
